content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need assistance with transferring data from a [product_name] [article_no] PLC to Excel. I've checked various Excel sheets that log values, but what I need is a way to display only the latest value—updating a single cell in Excel as the value changes. Thanks.

Hello [user_name], the feature you're looking for is available in [product_name] [article_no]. If you scroll to the bottom of the toolbar, you'll find 'DATA Log Profile > Data Log.' The help documentation provides instructions on how to program this function and transfer data via CSV format. Does this address your question?

Thank you for the information, and sorry for the late reply! Do you know of any SCADA systems or methods that can communicate with this PLC besides [product_name] Monitor software? I once set up communication between [product_name] and Wonderware SCADA using the Excel method, but it was unreliable and often disconnected. Could you please get back to me as soon as possible? Thanks in advance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for reliable solutions to transfer real-time data from a legacy PLC into Excel, preferring updates in a single cell as values change. Connectivity to third-party SCADA applications is also a concern, with current methods proving unstable and inadequate for consistent real-time monitoring.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a straightforward and dependable way to stream real-time PLC data into a single cell in Excel, without unstable connections or manual data manipulation.
